name: Fuel
tagline: Log meals by text and get calories, protein and a grade for the day
description: Message what you just ate and it counts the calories and protein toward your daily target, no spreadsheet needed. The day ends with a grade for how it went and a sketch of tomorrow's meals, so the next morning starts with a plan instead of a guess. You report; it counts and plans.
author: arouch_serg
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
